newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids mixed, slow sales.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids mixed, slow sales.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids were mixed on Tuesday in lackluster activity, dealers said.
"People are finding wheat movement very slow," a Minneapolis dealer said.
Country movement has been pretty much shut off and people are waiting for direction from the board. "Mills are kind of scrambling for wheat," he said.
MGE December wheat was off 1-1/2 cents to end at $4.22-1/4 a bushel.
In Montana, the focus was on winter wheat seeding.
Although the forecast called for cold temperatures at around 30 degrees Fahrenheit for Tuesday evening, Montana dealers said they expect the weather to have very little impact on winter seeding.
About 35 to 40 percent of the winter wheat has already been seeded in Montana, one dealer said.
